name: Example Client
description: A minimal example client template shipped with client-intelligence v1.0.0. Demonstrates the template structure with one mandatory field and three optional fields. Delete and replace with your own templates as your org's needs become clearer.

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: The official name of the client company or organization.

fields.name: primary_contact_name
fields.description: Name of the primary contact at this client.

fields.name: primary_contact_email
fields.description: Email address of the primary contact.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text notes about this client — relationship history, important context, anything that doesn't fit a structured field.
